authentication_key.title: Authentication Key
authentication_key.description: Key that later unlock uses once. The model must not change it.

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: Contact or User id returned by the verification flow.

door_case_id.title: Door Case Id
door_case_id.description: Door Access Case created with Status New when the email was sent.

email_matched.title: Email Matched
email_matched.description: True only when the typed email equals the email on the Contact record.

email_sent.title: Email Sent
email_sent.description: True only when the verification email was sent.

rate_limited.title: Rate Limited
rate_limited.description: True when the three-codes-per-hour limit was reached and no code was sent.
